entry.title: The capped entry
entry.summary: The one sidebar entry that stands for a capped hub's pages.
entry.content: The entry reads “5 pages” here. Its text comes from the sidebar.cappedLabel site option, else the dockitty.sidebar.cappedEntry UI string for the page’s language, else “{count} pages”. It links to the hub, and it is marked as the current page on every page below the hub.
